admission.justification: Spans mcp/pyproject.toml and mcp/uv.lock, is proven by test_installed_mcp_meets_declared_floor_and_server_lists_tools, and prevents PyPI installs from selecting an mcp release below 2.3.0 (missing MCPServer.remove_tool or the 2.x SEP-2133 Extension API and re-exposing pre-2.3.0 advisories) or crossing into mcp 3.x.

applicability: The installable agents-remember-mcp package's mcp dependency specifier, its resolved Python lockfile, and the MCPServer startup path.
conditions: mcp/pyproject.toml declares a single mcp dependency with a >=2.3.0 floor and <3 ceiling.
The installed mcp release satisfies the declared specifier and exposes MCPServer.remove_tool.
exclusions: A later migration to mcp 3.x that replaces the MCPServer 2.x API.
Other dependency version ranges declared in mcp/pyproject.toml.
statement: The mcp dependency in mcp/pyproject.toml requires at least 2.3.0 and below 3, mcp/uv.lock resolves an admissible 2.x release, and the installed distribution exposes MCPServer.remove_tool so unbound and role-bound servers list their tools.
title: Declared mcp floor stays at least 2.3.0 and below 3
